name: Buffalo Wings with Carrots, Celery & Homemade Blue Cheese Dressing

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken wings, split with tips removed
3 tbsp cornstarch
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until wings are cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add blue cheese to the bowl with the yogurt mixture and stir to combine the dressing. Transfer dressing to a serving bowl (if desired) and place on a serving platter.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim carrots; quarter lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the platter with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve celery lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the platter and set aside.
Place hot sauce and butter in a small saucepan set over medium heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until the wing sauce is warm and combined. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup hot sauce
1 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, remove from the oven and transfer to a clean large bowl. Drizzle with the wing sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, add wings to the platter with the dressing, carrots, and celery. Enjoy!
